Dear Customer,

Thank you for contacting our support team regarding your billing inquiry. We have successfully initiated a refund of **$240** for the incorrect plan tier billing in your previous month’s statement.

**Refund Details:**
- Amount: **$240**
- Reason: Overbilling due to incorrect plan tier (SILVER).
- Expected Processing Time: **3–5 business days** (refund will appear as a credit on your card or next bill, depending on your payment method).

We apologize for any inconvenience caused. If you have any questions or require further assistance, please reply to this email or contact our support team.

Best regards,
[Company Name] Support Team
